manual: Build with community-apps/omawrite/install.sh. Prefers CMake; falls back to omawrite.pro + qmake6.
Uses QApplication + PrintSupport for system print; Quick Dialogs for file choosers.
If apt cannot match libqt6core for qml6-module-qtquick-dialogs, place QtQuick/Dialogs under ~/.local/lib/qt6/qml/ — install.sh wraps the binary.
